image_description: A red and silver minibus (van-based) parked in a lot. The vehicle features a two-tone paint job with a red upper body and silver lower body separated by a chrome strip. It has a large windshield, side windows, standard wheels, and visible headlights. Palm trees are visible in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic van-derived boxy silhouette of a minibus, distinct from full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield and multiple side windows are clearly visible and structurally sound.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus, and the sliding door track/handle is visible on the side.
The panel gaps and handle indicate a sliding side door, typical for this class of vehicle.
The short hood and grille placement indicate a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame; cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a distinct red and silver two-tone livery, which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Wheels are visible, round, and appear to have standard steel rims with hubcaps.
The window configuration suggests seating capacity within the 4-10 range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the front license plate is illegible and appears as blurred gibberish rather than clear alphanumeric characters, a common AI artifact.
The internal structure of the headlight lacks crisp definition and appears slightly melted or smudged compared to real automotive lighting.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle classification and distinguish it from similar van classes.
To verify the structural integrity of the wheels and ensure they are properly grounded without floating or melting into the pavement.
To check for boundary bleeding between the vehicle and the background, and ensure window frames are topologically correct.
To rigorously analyze the legibility of the license plate and any manufacturer badges, confirming the severity of text artifacts.

focus_areas: Wheel geometry and contact points with ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate; AI often fails here. Verify if the wheel rims are circular and symmetric, as elliptical wheels are a common geometric failure. Check if the reflection on the car body matches the environment logically.
